retained_failures: The local GitHub CLI prerequisite reports an invalid keyring token. The already connected GitHub application created and reads draft PR #29, so no credential or access setting was changed and no gh mutation result is used as evidence.

A verifier-inventory search passed a Windows wildcard path literally to ripgrep, which rejected it before inventory output; the corrected -g query and explicit filesystem inventory identify 40 applicable validators.

The first exact-head validator wrapper incorrectly supplied --require-selection to the excluded v4 contract and correctly failed with selection_required after 32 passes; the unchanged phase-correct successor passes all 40 with v4 implemented and excluded.

A combined structured-parse and boundary-scan wrapper returned no usable result at its command boundary; split exact successors pass 1019 JSON files, 164 JSONL files with 30085 records, post-test additions, model-artifact inventory, and clean-worktree checks.

The first live image-custody assertion produced a false mismatch because ConvertFrom-Json parsed image creation times as DateTime and string conversion localized them; an intermediate display wrapper also contained an empty pipeline element. The explicit UTC-format successor proves all three tag identities and creation times exact.
A candidate-failure projection first attempted to overwrite PowerShell's reserved false constant; the corrected variable reports exactly five false gates without mutating evidence.
One final GitHub orientation wrapper omitted spaces around Get-Date's -Format argument and stopped after read-only queries; the corrected exact query reports CLEAN and MERGEABLE at the audited head.

The first local audit-validation wrapper omitted a space before PowerShell output redirection, so json.tool received a nonexistent filename ending in greater-than; the corrected command validates the unchanged report and the independent audit evaluator computes verified with no warning.

The first clean clone, the first package/source attempt, public-byte decoding and line-ending mismatches, lifecycle-test fixture failures, validator orchestration failures, staging and push wrappers, and container process observations remain retained under artifacts/verification and contracts/milestone-0031.json.

The v4 candidate remains unfavorable and retained: five of 136 Boolean gates are false, baseline disposition is remediate, adversarial retrieval-stage compatibility fails, and median latency regresses despite improved returned-set focus.
limitations: GitHub has no configured checks or required review for PR #29, so project-owned candidate, clean-clone, real-surface, exact-head review, and direct public-state gates are authoritative.
The local gh keyring token is stale; this audit uses the existing connected GitHub application for mutations and anonymous GitHub APIs for independent public reads without changing access.
All evaluation and incident evidence is deterministic and synthetic; it is not production reliability, externally validated relevance, or universal prompt-injection resistance.
The v4 candidate improves focus but is excluded; no broad Pareto or superior-retriever claim is supported.

Expected document IDs denote frozen required evidence and are not exhaustive relevance labels; externally assigned trust-tier metadata is not authoritative until authenticated and normalized outside the model.
Local model hardware and energy cost are unestimated, and zero external API cost does not establish production economics.
The exact image reproducibility claim is bounded to the verified Docker, Buildx, BuildKit, driver, frozen base digest, source inputs, and clean-clone workflow.
Docker Scout evidence is point-in-time and does not establish perpetual vulnerability freedom.
No production identity, external collector, signer, paid service, package registry, container registry, deployment, or real infrastructure is included.
The container image is a local verification surface and will not be exported, pushed, published, or redistributed.
